name: NIH ChestX-ray14
description: A dataset of 112,120 frontal-view chest X-ray images from 30,805 patients, labeled with up to 14 thoracic disease findings, released by the NIH Clinical Center for chest radiograph classification and localization research.
citation: Wang, X., Peng, Y., Lu, L., Lu, Z., Bagheri, M., and Summers, R. M. (2017). ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2097-2106. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2017.369

license.notes: The dataset is provided for research use under NIH Clinical Center terms; no standard SPDX license is asserted. Consult the upstream terms for access and permitted use.
